notes: Traced unchanged Chamber_04.jpeg in 1536x1024 top-left pixels using full image and eight magnified coordinate-grid crops. Collision traces stone contact only; silhouettes independently trace visible columns, basalt, lintels, arches and braziers.

The main connected stone route runs from the west gate approach across the southwest zigzag causeway to the southeast arrival platform. The broad bright lava river separates the east circular arena and northern islands from this route. The single-boundary navigation schema cannot represent disconnected surfaces; those islands are deliberately outside the playable boundary, with visible occluders retained. No floor bridge is invented through lava.

The rough catalog west exit (280,437) is lava in front of the arch, and arrival (1240,850) is cliff/column shaft above the arrival floor. Safe approach and arrival anchors were moved onto painted stone at (352,464) and (1178,939). Return exit is at the southeast visible stone apron (1335,986), because the apparent arch opening is lava rather than a walkable threshold.

The arena encounter center and its isolated enemy locations were moved onto the connected causeway. The east arena remains a visible background island; restoring gameplay there requires explicit traversal or multiple navigation regions, and is not supported by a false stone bridge.

Thin glowing fissures embedded in otherwise continuous stone slabs are surface decoration. Broad river/lava-fall areas, vertical cliff faces and projecting ruin caps are excluded. The narrowest supported link near (1020,812) is checked at radius 0.45 world units.

Physical footprints use lowest stone contact rather than cap width or screen-space column height. Tall silhouettes can hide the player over walkable paving behind the base. West large arch, west small arch and arrival arch are separated into piers/lintel silhouettes to preserve their open interiors.

Off-route northern platform columns and arch piers are retained as explicit occluders where visible. Distant landscape spires and lava cliffs do not extend over the playable route and are not individual collision objects.

Confidence: sharp platform edges and column bases generally 5-10 pixels; painterly lava/stone edge and dark arrival platform 10-18 pixels; arrival floor hidden by the pillar/ridge 15-25 pixels. Underlying floor around the arrival column is inferred only between visible contiguous stone patches. The disconnected arena interpretation is a material gameplay limitation, not a claim that its painted stone is physically absent.
